This wrapper exposes selected PhyKIT tree and alignment metrics.

Input modes

Single-file mode preserves the direct PhyKIT output for one tree or alignment. Collection mode runs the selected metric for each member of one Galaxy collection and writes a combined table. Grouped-collection mode accepts repeated group labels plus collections and writes a long table suitable for downstream group comparison tools.

ZIP archive modes are convenience inputs for archive-heavy histories.
